mechanism: Nicotine induces CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, increasing risperidone metabolism and potentially reducing antipsychotic efficacy; nicotine also increases sympathomimetic effects and may worsen orthostatic hypotension.
action: Monitor antipsychotic efficacy closely; dosage adjustment of risperidone may be necessary; counsel on smoking cessation; assess for worsening psychotic symptoms or cardiovascular effects.
